information.about: Sahkō sources and roasts single-origin specialty coffee for cafés, restaurants and people who care how their coffee was grown.
information.wholesale: For wholesale pricing, samples and standing orders, email us with your volumes and roast preferences.

about.photoAlt: A picker reaching into coffee trees, from the Sahkō brand file
paragraphs: Sahkō roasts single-origin coffee in small lots and publishes what it knows about each one: region, varietal, altitude, process, harvest, acidity, body, roast and lot number.
The collection is short on purpose. Six coffees, each chosen for a character that survives the roast and reads clearly in the cup.

wholesale.intro: For cafés, restaurants and retail partners. Tell us about your volumes, equipment and the profiles you pour and we will reply with samples and current availability.
